Messages.Author: The Hontz's
Messages.Body:
There isn't a Sabbat War article in the new Scrye. They have a
paragraph about Sabbat War in their release section (though they call it
Sabbat Wars, like it's Star Wars or something!) It just mentions that
the set has sol out (we knew that!) However, the info might be old, as
it states that the set won't be reprinted, when Steve Wieck directly
posted to this group stating otherwise. There is some brief info on
Final Nights, which Scrye says will ship in May (I thought WW was aiming
for March!)

Jeff
